title: Grilled Shrimp Skewers with Portuguese Seasoning
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make dish perfect for a summer evening, featuring succulent shrimp marinated in a blend of Portuguese spices and grilled to perfection.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together Portuguese seasoning, olive oil, garlic, lemon juice, and salt.
Add the shrimp to the marinade and mix to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread the shrimp onto the skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and season with salt.
Grill the skewers for 2-3 minutes per side, or until the shrimp are pink and cooked through.
Serve immediately, garnished with fresh parsley if desired.
